title: digitalis purpurea f. dubia
intro: Digitalis purpurea f. dubia, commonly known as the purple foxglove, is a variant of the Digitalis purpurea plant, which is a flowering plant in the foxglove family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of heart conditions such as atrial fibrillation and congestive heart failure. The therapeutic actions of Digitalis purpurea f. dubia are attributed to its ability to increase the force of cardiac contractions, improve cardiac output, and slow the heart rate. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardiac glycosides, such as digoxin and digitoxin, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
